kind: archival re-analysis, zero new simulation (capacity discipline: load15 >= 100)
written_before: the re-judgement code ran for the first time
not_blinded_because: round-8 docs already quote the error at I_target for mu_full (tail) and mu_full_zz; H2/H3/H4 concern quantities not published anywhere in the repo at pre-registration time

abscissae_under_test.I_target: imposed platen rate, applied pressure (= the pre-registered abscissa of round 8 P3)
abscissae_under_test.I_imposed_measP: imposed platen rate, measured pressure (the artefact field misleadingly named I_measured)
abscissae_under_test.I_vol: volume-averaged measured affine strain rate, measured pressure (the pair that matches the volume-averaged ordinate mu_full)
abscissae_under_test.I_bulk: volume-averaged measured rate, archived bulk (slab / full-cell) pressure

hypotheses.H1_abscissa_matters: max over points |I_vol / I_target - 1| >= 0.10, i.e. the abscissa choice is not cosmetic
hypotheses.H2_abscissa_explains_the_error: at I_vol, |mu_full(tail) / mu_ref - 1| <= 10% on >= 3 of 4 points of the full_cell arm
hypotheses.H3_window_stability: signed error of mu_full(tail) and mu_full_final have the same sign at all 4 points (the round-8 verdict cannot be an artefact of the 60%-vs-20% window choice)
hypotheses.H4_gate_restricted: restricting to points that pass the device's own constant-stress gate (servo_valid), |mu_full / mu_ref - 1| <= 10% at the gate-passing points under at least one abscissa

falsification_rule: a hypothesis that fails is reported as FAIL; the ledger row is not closed on any cell of the matrix unless every gate-passing point is inside the band for that cell
expected_if_H2_fails: the abscissa is a real identification defect but not the source of the -27% deficit; round 9's wide cell (cj1584) remains the decisive test
